about: Entirely fictional acceptance cases (status family I-5 with sub-codes I-5-1 bamboo-blind maker, I-5-2 hanji papermaker, I-5-3 mother-of-pearl inlayer, I-5-4 onggi kiln trainee; the other-family codes H-9 and H-9-1; invented agency 가상 다솜이주청 (the 'Dasom agency'), regions 가상 해오름 관할 / 가상 들꽃 관할, office 가상 두레 출장소, documents 가상 I-5 체류 수첩, 가상 I-5 국외 체류자 알림문, I-5 Craft Stay Manual (fictional), Sổ tay cư trú I-5 (giả định), I-5 Overseas Stayers Manual (fictional), 가상 I-5 수수료·처리기간 알림, amounts and dates); not law. Authored only from trusted_evidence_spec.md (005-W revision: 고르는 질문 표시, the choice_codes of contract v17 given on the first call, with the 005-V choice_retry as second line, the 005-U conflict_records, the 005-T status retry, the 005-S cap and 005-R two-case paragraphs and section 6); the 005-V acceptance suite was read for format only (schema, case keys, registry shape, the expected block, mention-group and forbidden-pattern notation), the gate v18 constants, validate_suite and registry_for for structure, the 005-V manifest thresholds, and evidence_registry for content_sha256 and record_problems. No implementation, run output, test, review file or other suite's expected results were read, the pipeline was not run, and all questions, records and patterns were written fresh; other suites were searched only for duplicate questions and reused names. Focus, choice questions (spec 4 and 5, 005-W): two sibling sub-codes with a choosing word and one admissible record naming both, so the first call carries choice_codes; one choice case per category: A05W-02 (vi, verified_official), A05W-45 (ko question, English evidence, multilingual), A05W-62 (en, releasable_answer), A05W-68 (en question, Vietnamese reply, explicit_language_request), A05W-70 (ko, evidence_named_code), A05W-81 (vi, subcode_split); the matching code is the question's second code in 45, 62 and 81. A correct answer names the matching code with the asked value and also what the evidence gives for the other code, so the mention groups are both codes and both values. Choice near-misses, where neither choice_codes nor the retry applies: A05W-18 (a sub-code with its own parent I-5), A05W-58 (second code H-9 never named by the evidence), A05W-60 (two codes without a choosing word). Kept from 005-V: conflict-template cases A05W-28, 29, 30, 44, 56, 59, 67 (28, 29, 30, 44, 67 ask what each text says); not-conflicts A05W-31, 32, 33; partial traps A05W-36, 42, 61; cap positives A05W-01, 03, 37; two-case positives A05W-16, 40, 43; role reversal A05W-14, 25, 78. Ambiguities recorded: (1) Spec 4 (005-W) says that with choice_codes the model writes which code applies and what the evidence says about the other code with its citation; it does not say whether the other code's value is required. Because 'what the evidence says' about the other code is its value here and the raw channel scores the first answer, the other code's value is a mention group; the system notice of the choice retry can only add a missing code sentence. (2) Spec 4 (005-W) 'the codes the part's admissible evidence names' is read as codes written in the admissible text; in every choice case the codes are also in status_scope, so either reading gives the same choice_codes. (3) 'or', 'hay' and 'nào' also occur inside other words (for, report, thay); the choice and near-miss decisions were written so that they do not depend on substring matches: every question with two codes either has a whole-word choosing word or is Korean with none, and no two-code question contains 'thay'. (4) Question procedure words were kept to one procedure per question (change words 변경/change/thay đổi were avoided). (5) No forbidden pattern binds a value to a code; value patterns forbid inadmissible values only, and polarity and role patterns are lexical and sentence-scoped, each tested with correct (including value-first) and wrong answers in its language. (6) Mention groups assume the 005-S normalisation (lower case, whitespace removed).

One admissible record names both codes (status_scope has both), so the question is not split by sub-code (spec 4, 005-J) and there is no conflict pair (one record). Because the question is a choice question and the part's admissible evidence names both codes, the first call carries choice_codes ["I-5-2", "I-5-3"] in question order (spec 4, 005-W, contract v17) without saying which is right; the model must say which code applies and also cite what the evidence says for the other code.
